strings.greeting: Ask a question about this lesson. The answer comes from the lesson text.
strings.cloudConsent: Optional: if checked, your question and matched course section may be sent to this site's configured cloud AI. If unchecked, course search is used.
strings.notFound: I could not find this in the course
strings.listening: Listening with speech recognition. Review the words before sending.
strings.recording: Recording a voice note for a tutor. It will not be sent to the assistant.
strings.recordedReady: Voice note ready. It will only be sent to a tutor.
strings.speechAdded: Speech added to your question. Review it before sending.
strings.voiceUnavailable: Speech recognition failed and voice recording is unavailable.
strings.speechLimitations: Speech recognition and voices depend on your browser, device, and selected language. Review recognized words before sending.
strings.noSpeechVoice: No voice for the selected language is available on this device.
strings.consent: Share this conversation with a tutor
strings.escalationSent: Your request is queued. Tutors may be unavailable, including at 23:00. Response times vary and are not guaranteed. Return here and choose Check for tutor reply.
strings.tutorAvailability: Tutors may be unavailable, including at 23:00. Requests are queued, but response times vary and are not guaranteed. Return here and choose Check for tutor reply.
strings.tutorReplyPending: No reply yet. Your request is still waiting. Check again later.
strings.tutorUpdateAvailable: A tutor sent an update. Your request is still open; check again later for a final reply.
strings.tutorReplyAvailable: A tutor replied. The response is shown in this chat.
strings.checkTutorReplyFailed: Could not check for a tutor reply. Check your connection and try again.
strings.ticketDataFailed: Could not manage this request. Check your connection and try again.
strings.ticketDataDeleteConfirm: Permanently delete this tutor request and its attachments?
strings.ticketDataNote: This browser stores a private ticket key for export and deletion. Keep this browser data private.
strings.clearLocalDataConfirm: Clear local chat history, queued questions, cached lesson data, and saved ticket keys from this browser? This does not delete server tickets.
strings.clearLocalDataDone: Local assistant data cleared. Server tickets are unchanged unless you delete them above.
strings.clearLocalDataFailed: Could not clear this browser's assistant data. Use the browser's site-data controls.
strings.escalationFailed: Your request could not be sent. Check your connection and try again.
strings.offlineSaved: Saved on this phone. It will send when you are online.
strings.phoneInvalid: Enter an Ethiopian number starting with 09, 07, +2519, or +2517.
strings.accommodationButton: I need an accommodation for my interview
strings.accommodationPrivacy: Your accommodation choices and note go only to a tutor. They are never shared with an employer.
strings.whichJob: Which test job is your interview for?
strings.sendAccommodation: Ask a tutor about this accommodation
strings.accommodationSent: Your request was sent privately to a tutor.
strings.accommodationFailed: Your request could not be sent. Please try again.
strings.screenShareConsent: I consent to sharing my screen or page details with a tutor. Sharing starts only after I press a button. Live video is not recorded or stored. Page sharing sends this page URL, the focused element's accessible name and HTML, page headings, and only a screenshot I select; these are attached to a tutor request.
strings.screenShareNote: Use HTTPS for screen capture. Desktop uses direct demo WebRTC with no configured STUN/TURN relay, so some networks may block it. On Android Chrome, live screen sharing is unavailable; you can share page details and optionally upload a screenshot instead.
strings.screenContextStart: Show my tutor where I am
strings.screenShareConnecting: Waiting for the tutor to connect (demo transport).
strings.screenShareConnected: Connected to the tutor. Live video is not recorded.
strings.screenSharePermissionDenied: Screen access was not allowed. Check your browser permissions.
strings.screenShareDisconnected: The screen connection was lost. You can still stop sharing.
strings.screenShareError: Screen sharing could not start. Please try again.
strings.screenContextSent: Page details were sent to the tutor. This did not share your live screen.
strings.screenContextFailed: Page details could not be sent. Please try again.
strings.screenShareCleanupFailed: Screen sharing stopped, but demo signaling could not be cleared.
strings.screenScreenshotTooLarge: Choose an image smaller than 3 MB.
strings.translationUnavailable: This translation could not be loaded. English is being shown.
strings.describeOther: Describe the accommodation you need in the note.
